dedupe_keys.name: 臺中市地形圖之公用事業網路資料 telecommunications

description: 臺中市地形圖之公用事業網路資料 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府數位發展局. 臺中市公用事業網路，是約87至89年的1/1000地形圖案所附帶產生的圖資，為航照後產生，未經地面修測，其名稱"公用事業網路"是沿用當時的1/1000圖層名稱，內容並非道路資訊，而是1/1000案所附帶產生的各類人手孔圖資，此檔案後來並未隨台中市公共管線資料案的發展而更新，而是保留原檔案，因年代已久，相關內容已不可考，僅留存圖資作為"典藏... Coverage: Taichung City. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府數位發展局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
